full_prompt_en: A square academic oil painting shows an elegantly dressed group gathered around a small crimson-draped table in a richly furnished, dim salon. The background is layered with dark paneling, a gilt-framed picture high on the wall, palm fronds, and a deep red upholstered chair. At the far left, a large arrangement of pale pink and cream flowers rises from a vessel, its blossoms catching small highlights against the dark room. In the left foreground, a woman in a plum off-shoulder gown sits with her back and profile to the viewer; the long satin skirt spills in heavy folds across the tiled floor. At the center table, a young man in a dark military-style coat with gold shoulder details bends toward a sheet of paper and appears to write. On the right of the table, a woman with copper-blond hair and a light floral hairpiece leans her head into one hand. Her ivory and gold dress drapes over a carved chair and falls toward the floor, making a bright diagonal across the otherwise red-brown scene. Two additional figures stand behind, one in a mauve dress and one partly hidden near the far right. The faces and gestures suggest a quiet, absorbed conversation rather than a public spectacle. Warm interior light from the upper left catches bare shoulders, flowers, gilded trim, cream fabric, and the paper, leaving the wall and recesses in deep brown shadow. Smooth modeling of skin contrasts with more visibly worked brush texture in fabric, flowers, and floor. Rich burgundy, warm ivory, gold, and dark green control the palette. No written words are legible on the paper. The overall composition is intimate and theatrical, arranging pale illuminated figures and luxurious fabric around the central red table.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形学院派油画呈现一群衣着华美的人围在铺着猩红桌布的小桌旁，室内是一间陈设繁复而昏暗的沙龙。背景层叠着深色墙板、墙上高处的金色画框、棕榈枝叶和深红软垫椅。最左侧，一大束浅粉和奶油色花从花器中升起，花朵在暗房间前接住细小高光。左侧前景，一名穿梅紫露肩长裙的女子以背影和侧影面向观者；长缎裙以沉重褶皱铺在拼砖地面上。中央桌边，一名穿有金色肩部细节的深色军装式外套的年轻男子俯向一张纸，似乎正在书写。桌子右边，一名铜金色头发、佩浅色花饰的女子一手支着头。她的象牙白与金色长裙垂过雕花椅子，落向地面，在其余红褐色场景里形成明亮斜线。后方另站两人，一人穿紫灰长裙，另一人局部藏在最右侧。面孔与动作暗示安静投入的交流，而非公开表演。来自左上的暖室内光照亮裸肩、花朵、镀金边饰、奶油色布料和纸，墙与凹处留在深褐影中。平滑的肌肤塑形对照布料、花和地面更可见的绘画笔触。浓郁酒红、暖象牙白、金色和深绿控制配色。纸上没有可辨认的文字。整体构图亲密而戏剧化，让浅色受光人物与奢华布料围绕中央红桌排列。
style_prompt_en: The academic oil-painting style combines carefully modeled luminous surfaces with rich, dark surroundings. Burgundy, umber, antique gold, warm ivory, and restrained deep green form a luxurious low-key palette. Soft directional light gathers on a few prominent forms and material highlights, while background recesses remain brown-black and quiet. Draped curves, carved detail, and small organic clusters create an elaborate rhythm around a compact center. Smooth transitions give selected surfaces a polished volume; more visible strokes and layered color describe fabric, ornament, and floor. Overlapping forms establish shallow but convincing depth, and a pale diagonal balances broad dark vertical areas. The overall effect is elegant, theatrical, and intimate, with concentrated light organizing abundance rather than making every detail equally bright.
style_prompt_zh: 这种学院派油画风格把精心塑形的明亮表面与浓厚暗色环境结合。酒红、赭棕、古金、暖象牙白和克制深绿构成奢华的低明度配色。柔和定向光聚在少数突出形体与材料高光上，背景凹处保持棕黑而安静。垂坠曲线、雕刻细节与小型有机簇团围绕紧凑中心形成繁复节奏。平滑过渡给予选中表面光洁体积，较可见的笔触与层叠颜色则描写织物、装饰和地面。形体重叠建立浅而可信的纵深，一道浅色斜线平衡宽大的深色竖向区域。整体效果优雅、戏剧化且亲密，集中的光组织丰盛细节，却不让每处同样明亮。
theme_en: An elegant group gathered around a crimson table in a dark salon
theme_zh: 昏暗沙龙中围坐猩红桌边的华服人群
name: Alexandre Cabanel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
